    Propositions 7.9 and 12.8 with characters in W(P) #

    prop:family-criterion and prop:polynomial-mesh-comparison, for a basic connected representation-finite algebra A in characteristic two, with the residual characters χ_i = w(p_i) − ν_{v_i} in the weight lattice L = W(P) of the universal mesh weight w (Lemma 7.4), as in the source. The rows are those of Proposition 6.1 (residual_dual), of length at least three (shorter rows carry no cokernel class); their characters are pairwise distinct and part of an integer basis of W(P) (Proposition 7.5), and have degree len p_i − 2 (rowsWP). The family statements are the generic ones of FamilyCriterionGen.lean and PolynomialMesh.lean for this weight.

      Proposition 12.8 (prop:polynomial-mesh-comparison) for a basic connected representation-finite algebra in characteristic two, with the residual characters in W(P): for the rows of Proposition 6.1 (of length at least three) and the universal mesh weight, every family μ_i indexed by I = I₀ with the hypotheses of Proposition 7.9 has polynomial lifts with retained mesh coefficients a_i t_i, a_i ≠ 0, presenting every fibre, whose modules exhaust the indecomposables of the fibre (PolyMeshStmtG).
